Inspect a Pool

Source: R/pool.R
mizu_pool_status.Rd

A read-only snapshot of the pool region: registry states, parked-worker count, queued injection entries, and result-slot occupancy.

Usage

mizu_pool_status(pool)

Arguments

pool

a pool handle from mizu_pool() or mizu_pool_attach(); inside a task, the evaluating worker's own handle from mizu_current_pool().

Value

A list with elements name, role, max_workers, max_submitters, injection_cap, result_slots, slot_size, workers (per-slot states), parked, submitters (per-slot states), injection (entries queued and unclaimed), tasks (result slots by state: pending / ok / err / cancel / died), deque (per-worker deque depths), and shutdown.

Examples

p <- mizu_pool()
mizu_pool_status(p)
#> $name
#> [1] "/mizu_1ac0_d4865e92"
#> 
#> $role
#> [1] "controller"
#> 
#> $max_workers
#> [1] 1
#> 
#> $max_submitters
#> [1] 8
#> 
#> $injection_cap
#> [1] 1024
#> 
#> $result_slots
#> [1] 4096
#> 
#> $slot_size
#> [1] 512
#> 
#> $workers
#> [1] "live"
#> 
#> $parked
#> [1] 1
#> 
#> $submitters
#> [1] "live" "free" "free" "free" "free" "free" "free" "free"
#> 
#> $injection
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $tasks
#> pending      ok     err  cancel    died 
#>       0       0       0       0       0 
#> 
#> $deque
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $shutdown
#> [1] FALSE
#> 
mizu_pool_stop(p)
